text: Dr. Jasmine Suriya, MD was extremely helpful and thorough. She diagnosed me with Upper respiratory tract infection with Eustachian tube dysfunction causing ear blockage, which makes perfect sense. I was really surprised my ears weren’t full of wax or water, because they’re so stuffed. The Eustschian tube dysfunction makes it make sense. I also got a nebulizer treatment, because my lungs were too closed to let in good medicine (I have Sarcoidosis, so my breathing is bad, anyhow). I’m glad to finally know what’s been bothering me the last ten days. Everyone who works there are really kind and supportive. They made me feel safe and not alone. My friend was bitten by a dog on Koh Mak. After we continued our travels and arrived in Phuket, we still had to go to the hospital for daily wound irrigation. Up until then, the wound was healing perfectly, and my friend had no problems. We specifically chose a private clinic to ensure the best possible care. During the treatment, the nurse injected two syringes full of chlorhexidine deep into the wound. (Unfortunately, at the time, we were unaware that warnings about this active ingredient had been issued in Germany and Europe for years – see attachment). The liquid remained in the wound, spread throughout his leg, and even formed a mound beneath the skin.

My friend asked the nurse if this was normal. The nurse then said that this was normal and would disappear after a few hours. That same evening, my boyfriend's foot was very swollen and numb, and also extremely painful. We went back to the private clinic the next day because his foot was still swollen. When we asked the nurse why she had flooded the wound with so much fluid (which also remained in the wound), she said that this kind of reaction is quite common and normal.

We are very disappointed, as we didn't expect this in a private clinic!

We asked if we could speak to the doctor, but she suddenly refused to speak to us.

Unfortunately, we left this private clinic with more problems than when we arrived.

My boyfriend has been experiencing numbness for weeks!

We would not recommend this clinic.
